import sqlite3

import numpy as np

# 连接到SQLite数据库
conn = sqlite3.connect('⟨workdir⟩')

# 方法1: 使用SQL计算比值(整数除法)
print("方法1: 使用SQL计算比值(整数除法)...")
sql_query_int = 'SELECT "Item Code" / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Item Code") FROM sales_records) AS ratio_sql FROM sales_records'
df_sql_int = pd.read_sql_query(sql_query_int, conn)
print(f"SQL计算的前5行结果:")
print(df_sql_int.head())

# 方法2: 使用Python计算比值
print("\n方法2: 使用Python计算比值...")
count_distinct_query = 'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Item Code") as total_items FROM sales_records'
total_items = pd.read_sql_query(count_distinct_query, conn).iloc[0, 0]
print(f"去重后的Item Code数量: {total_items}")

df_py = pd.read_sql_query('SELECT "Item Code" FROM sales_records', conn)
df_py['ratio_py'] = df_py['Item Code'] / total_items
print(f"Python计算的前5行结果:")
print(df_py[['Item Code', 'ratio_py']].head())

# 验证两种方法的结果是否相等
print(f"\n数据行数: {len(df_sql_int)}")
print(f"方法1(整数除法)与方法2(Python浮点除法)的匹配情况:")
mismatch_count = sum(df_sql_int['ratio_sql'] != df_py['ratio_py'])
print(f"不匹配的行数: {mismatch_count} (占总行数的 {mismatch_count/len(df_sql_int)*100:.2f}%)")

# 解决方案1: 在SQL中使用浮点数转换
print("\n--- 解决方案1: 在SQL中使用浮点数转换 ---")
sql_query_float = 'SELECT CAST("Item Code" AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Item Code") FROM sales_records) AS ratio_sql_float FROM sales_records'
df_sql_float = pd.read_sql_query(sql_query_float, conn)
print(f"SQL浮点数转换后的前5行结果:")
print(df_sql_float.head())

# 验证SQL浮点数转换与Python结果的匹配情况
mismatch_count_float = sum(np.abs(df_sql_float['ratio_sql_float'] - df_py['ratio_py']) > 1e-10)
print(f"SQL浮点数转换与Python结果不匹配的行数: {mismatch_count_float}")

# 解决方案2: 使用显式的浮点数乘法
print("\n--- 解决方案2: 使用显式的浮点数乘法 ---")
sql_query_explicit = 'SELECT "Item Code" * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Item Code") FROM sales_records) AS ratio_sql_explicit FROM sales_records'
df_sql_explicit = pd.read_sql_query(sql_query_explicit, conn)
print(f"SQL显式浮点数乘法的前5行结果:")
print(df_sql_explicit.head())

# 验证SQL显式浮点数乘法与Python结果的匹配情况
mismatch_count_explicit = sum(np.abs(df_sql_explicit['ratio_sql_explicit'] - df_py['ratio_py']) > 1e-10)
print(f"SQL显式浮点数乘法与Python结果不匹配的行数: {mismatch_count_explicit}")

# 解决方案3: 使用ROUND函数进行精确比较
print("\n--- 解决方案3: 使用ROUND函数进行精确比较 ---")
sql_query_round = 'SELECT ROUND("Item Code" * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Item Code") FROM sales_records), 10) AS ratio_sql_round FROM sales_records'
df_sql_round = pd.read_sql_query(sql_query_round, conn)

# 在Python端也使用相同精度进行四舍五入
df_py['ratio_py_round'] = np.round(df_py['Item Code'] / total_items, 10)

print(f"SQL使用ROUND后的前5行结果:")
print(df_sql_round.head())
print(f"Python使用ROUND后的前5行结果:")
print(df_py[['Item Code', 'ratio_py_round']].head())

# 验证ROUND后的匹配情况
mismatch_count_round = sum(df_sql_round['ratio_sql_round'] != df_py['ratio_py_round'])
print(f"SQL和Python使用ROUND(10位小数)后不匹配的行数: {mismatch_count_round}")

# 如果没有完全匹配，尝试更高精度
if mismatch_count_round > 0:
    print("\n尝试更高精度...")
    for precision in [12, 14, 16]:
        sql_query_higher = f'SELECT ROUND("Item Code" * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Item Code") FROM sales_records), {precision}) AS ratio_sql_{precision} FROM sales_records'
        df_sql_higher = pd.read_sql_query(sql_query_higher, conn)
        df_py[f'ratio_py_{precision}'] = np.round(df_py['Item Code'] / total_items, precision)
        
        mismatch = sum(df_sql_higher[f'ratio_sql_{precision}'] != df_py[f'ratio_py_{precision}'])
        print(f"精度={precision}位小数时，不匹配的行数: {mismatch}")

# 最终验证
print("\n=== 最终结果验证 ===")

# 检查所有方法的完全匹配情况
if mismatch_count_explicit == 0:
    print("✅ SQL使用显式浮点数乘法('Item Code' * 1.0 / ...)与Python浮点除法完全匹配!")
    print(f"总行数: {len(df_sql_explicit)}")
    print(f"匹配行数: {len(df_sql_explicit)}")
    
    # 显示一些样本进行比较
    print("\n样本比较(前5行):")
    comparison_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'Item_Code': df_py['Item Code'].head(),
        'SQL_ratio': df_sql_explicit['ratio_sql_explicit'].head(),
        'Python_ratio': df_py['ratio_py'].head()
    })
    print(comparison_df)
    
    # 验证完全相等
    all_equal = np.allclose(df_sql_explicit['ratio_sql_explicit'].values, df_py['ratio_py'].values, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-12)
    print(f"\n所有行完全相等(容差1e-12): {all_equal}")
else:
    print("⚠️  某些行仍然存在差异。尝试使用CAST AS REAL或更高精度的ROUND。")
    
    # 使用CAST AS REAL再试一次
    print("\n尝试使用CAST AS REAL...")
    sql_query_cast = 'SELECT CAST("Item Code" AS REAL) / CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Item Code") FROM sales_records) AS REAL) AS ratio_sql_cast FROM sales_records'
    df_sql_cast = pd.read_sql_query(sql_query_cast, conn)
    
    mismatch_cast = sum(np.abs(df_sql_cast['ratio_sql_cast'] - df_py['ratio_py']) > 1e-12)
    print(f"使用CAST AS REAL后不匹配的行数: {mismatch_cast}")

# 关闭数据库连接
conn.close()

# 保存结果用于进一步分析
print("\n保存结果到CSV文件...")
result_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Item_Code': df_py['Item Code'],
    'SQL_ratio_float': df_sql_explicit['ratio_sql_explicit'] if 'ratio_sql_explicit' in locals() else df_sql_float['ratio_sql_float'],
    'Python_ratio': df_py['ratio_py'],
    'Difference': np.abs(df_sql_explicit['ratio_sql_explicit'] - df_py['ratio_py']) if 'ratio_sql_explicit' in locals() else np.abs(df_sql_float['ratio_sql_float'] - df_py['ratio_py'])
})
result_path = '⟨workdir⟩'
result_df.to_csv(result_path, index=False)
print(f"结果已保存到: {result_path}")
print(f"最大差异: {result_df['Difference'].max():.15f}")
```
